answers.evidence: The USB-C opening is an open slot facing the camera, with no closed body behind it.
The XLR/combo face with its pin ring and latch shows open toward the camera.
The barrel jack shows a bore with its center pin facing the camera, not a closed back panel.
The hex-nut 1/4 in jack shows an open threaded bore facing the camera.
A column of small SMD and electrolytic bodies floats off the board edge, to the right in top.png and to the left in bottom.png, with no pads beneath them.
J1 sits about 170 px above the single row of D2, C18 and the passives, so J1 is not in that row.
The two diodes sit side by side, but J106 is a dark block well above them and off their row.
The IC has two caps beside it at the same height, which makes a row, and only one cap above it.
The inductor, two caps and tantalum form a row, but the AP63205 IC sits about 160 px below that row.
One cap sits beside the IC at the same height and the other sits below it, so the parts do not line up in one column.
The inductor and two caps form a row, but the buck IC sits well above that row.
The SOT-23-5 LDO has one cap on each side at the same height.
The ferrite, the large yellow cap and the R151/R152/C163 group sit at three different heights.
D3 and R10 share a row, but the buck IC U3 sits about 300 px above it.
Y1 and its caps form a small cluster below and left of U1, not a straight row through U1.
A straight vertical stack of four small caps runs along the west side of U1.
The crop is unannotated, I can see only four caps in the west column and no identifiable ferrite, so I cannot tell which parts are FB1 and C8-C11.
The caps below U1 sit at two different heights, with the crystal among them, so they do not form one row.
The caps on U1's east side are roughly vertical but gapped, and the crop does not show which parts are C5, C13, C61, C6 and C32.
A row of caps runs along the top of U1 and the crop does not mark which one is C1.
I cannot identify R27 and R29 among the west-side passives in the unannotated crop.
I cannot identify R30 and C55 among the small parts around U1 in the unannotated crop.
SWRESET1, the cap and SWBOOT1 sit in a row about 180 px below and left of U1, so U1 is not in that row.
The J3 header sits level with U1's west edge, within U1's vertical extent, as a two-part row.
D1 and R3 sit side by side at the same height on U1's west side, level with pin 88.
The SOT-23 diode, the 100k resistor and the large electrolytic sit at scattered heights far from U104.
The mirrored leg's parts are scattered at different heights, with electrolytics well off any common line.
The coupling electrolytics and the 22k and 100k resistors sit in several clumps, not one row.
The small caps and resistors around U104 sit in two or three offset rows plus two large electrolytics, not one row.
The four resistors sit in two rows above and left of U105, and the 5VA decap sits lower, so there is no single row.
The cap, resistor and electrolytic sit above, below and beside U105 at different heights.
The cluster's passives are parked in the off-board staging column on the right, away from U8.
The passives are stacked in the off-board staging column on the right while U8 sits on the board, so the crop spans both and shows no column through U8.
The crop spans the board and the off-board staging column, so the supply caps are not placed in a column with U6.
The output network parts are off-board in the staging column, not in a row from U6.
The vref parts are in the off-board staging column, away from U106 on the board.
The buffer passives are in the off-board staging column, not beside U106.
The crop spans the board and the off-board staging column, so D104, R120 and C162 are not placed in a row with K101.
The mute-relay driver parts are in the off-board staging column, away from K102.
The pull-ups sit in a row at about y=620 and SW101 sits about 155 px above that row.
The filter caps sit in a row about 155 px below the toggles, so SW101 is not on that row.
The four passives form a row above ENC102, but the encoder body sits about 160 px below that row.
The four passives form a row above ENC103, but the encoder body sits about 170 px below that row.
Four passives sit above ENC101 and two sit below it, so the six do not share one row.
The caps and resistor are scattered at different x positions around U101, not stacked in a column.
C29 and C30 sit side by side between two pot rows, and RV111 is a pot body about 220 px above them.
R142 and R143 sit side by side above the OLED, but the J117 header is hidden under the OLED module so I cannot compare their positions.
Several top labels are rotated (R152/C163, D1, SWRESET1, U8), and ENC101-103, U104 and U105 labels overlap parts, with tiny bottom text.
The bottom render shows J106, J101 and J108 with refdes silkscreen and stray SMD bodies at the left, beyond the copper pour.
